user.title: Connect Park & Collect
user.description: Create an API key in the Park & Collect app under Profile → API access.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key is no longer valid. Create a new one in the app under Profile → API access.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, or the account has no signed power of attorney.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

submit_report.name: Submit report
submit_report.description: Sends a parking violation that a person has reviewed to Park & Collect.

parkplatz_id.name: Parking lot ID
parkplatz_id.description: ID of the parking lot. Without it, the default parking lot is used.

kennzeichen.name: License plate
kennzeichen.description: German license plate, reviewed by a person.

vertragsstrafe.name: Amount
vertragsstrafe.description: Amount in whole euros. Without it, the amount of the parking lot is used.

abmahnen.name: Cease-and-desist letter
abmahnen.description: Without it, the setting of the parking lot is used.

bilder.name: Photos
bilder.description: 1 to 3 local files (JPEG or PNG), as paths or as entries with pfad and aufgenommen_am.

vorgang_id.name: Event ID
vorgang_id.description: Unique ID of the parking event. Prevents duplicate reports. Without it, parking lot, plate and start are used.
